International Education Consultancy

Head Office:
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

Primary Focus:
Helping Indian students secure admissions to international universities and obtain student visas through end-to-end counselling and application support.

Mission:
To empower students with expert guidance for studying abroad by providing transparent counselling, university selection, admission assistance, visa support, and pre-departure services.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Excelencia International is a Mumbai-based overseas education consultancy that assists students throughout their international education journey. The company provides personalized counselling, university shortlisting, admission assistance, documentation support, student visa guidance, scholarship advice, SOP guidance, education loan assistance, and pre-departure support.

The consultancy works with students planning undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, master's, MBA, and specialized international education programs.
